name: Explore Mercado do Bolhão
description: Spend your Saturday wandering through the beautifully restored historic market. Browse stalls overflowing with fresh produce, fish, and flowers, then head upstairs for a delicious lunch.
longDescription:
Explore Mercado do Bolhão is a day-long opportunity to visit Porto's iconic market, a landmark that has served the city since 1893. Following extensive restoration, the market reopened in 2022, preserving its original neoclassical architecture while modernizing its facilities. It functions as a traditional municipal market, offering a wide array of fresh, local products directly from vendors.

Visitors can expect a lively atmosphere within the multi-level structure. The ground floor hosts numerous stalls selling fresh produce, seafood, meat, and flowers, providing a sensory experience of local commerce. The upper levels feature various restaurants and cafés, offering a chance to sample Portuguese cuisine made with ingredients sourced directly from the market below. The event is suitable for all ages and offers an authentic glimpse into daily life in Porto.

The event takes place on Saturday, October 24, 2026, starting at 08:00. Entry to Mercado do Bolhão is free, and no tickets are required. The market is centrally located on R. Formosa, 322, easily accessible via public transport. The Bolhão metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) is directly adjacent to the market, and numerous bus lines also serve the area. The venue is wheelchair accessible.
